live_bot_probe.scope: Actual Bot API availability at diagnosis time; production Agent/model turn not executed

diagnosis: No competing polling entry point found in inspected local processes or Docker containers. Bot API probes succeeded; original consumer may have exited or its request expired. API does not identify the conflicting host/process.
limitation: A persistently active other consumer must still be stopped by the deployment owner. Local locks do not coordinate across hosts.
